cards.example_en: These new shoes fit me after a week of walking.
cards.example_zh: 这双新鞋走了一个星期以后很合脚。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：组（名词）
cards.example_en: Our project group met in the library after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 我们的项目组午饭后在图书馆碰面。

cards.example_en: A hole in the tent let rain drip onto my sleeping bag.
cards.example_zh: 帐篷上有个洞，雨水滴到了我的睡袋上。

cards.example_en: Our school will host the city basketball final.
cards.example_zh: 我们学校将主办全市篮球决赛。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：识别；确认
cards.example_en: Can you identify the man in the photo?
cards.example_zh: 你能认出照片中的人吗？

cards.example_en: Her knowledge of maps helped the group finish the geography task.
cards.example_zh: 她的地图知识帮助小组完成了地理任务。

cards.example_en: The traffic law requires bike lights after dark in our city.
cards.example_zh: 交通法规定，在我们城里天黑后骑车必须亮灯。

cards.example_en: Can you lend me a pencil for the history quiz?
cards.example_zh: 历史小测时，你能借我一支铅笔吗？

cards.example_en: Early light came through the curtains and woke the baby.
cards.example_zh: 清晨的光透过窗帘，把宝宝弄醒了。

cards.example_en: Sand jammed the mechanism of the old classroom clock.
cards.example_zh: 沙子卡住了教室那座旧钟的机制。

cards.example_en: One spelling mistake cost him a mark on the dictation.
cards.example_zh: 一个拼写错误让他在听写里丢了一分。

cards.example_en: Count your money before you pay for the train ticket.
cards.example_zh: 买火车票之前，先把钱数清楚。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：普通的
cards.example_en: We ate ordinary bread and soup for dinner at home.
cards.example_zh: 我们在家晚饭吃了普通的面包和汤。

cards.example_en: I will pay for the noodles with my lunch card.
cards.example_zh: 我要用饭卡付面条的钱。

cards.example_en: Teams trust him because of his calm personality.
cards.example_zh: 因为他的人格很沉稳，队友们都信任他。
